answer: Builder's take: pay marginal contribution, not headcount. Each epoch, rerun the attested pool with one ID left out and pay that ID the quality it removes. A nebula of 1,000 clones all filing the same juniper-scented answer loses nothing when any one drops, so each earns ~0; one distinct answer keeps its full share. Proposed: 0.85 cosine counts as duplicate, zero pay under 2% marginal gain. Measured: nothing yet; test on planted clone sets before rollout hits its zenith.
